newsitem.title: USA: NIH gives IGEN rights to HIV immunoassay.
newsitem.headline: NIH gives IGEN rights to HIV immunoassay.

text.p: IGEN International INc said on Wednesday it obtained worldwide rights to an immunoassay for detection of the HIV-1 virus from the U.S. National Institutes of Health.

An immunoassay measures the presence of a protein using an antibody antigen reaction, the company said. IGEN said its immunoassay also measured viral load, which was linked to the severity of the HIV virus.
IGEN said it planned to develop the test for clinical research use in combination with its proprietary ORIGEN detection technology.
The company said the HIV-1 p7 immunoassay, which detected levels of a protein called nucleocapsid antigen p7, promised to have advantages over existing HIV-1 quantitation methods.
